mentionReverseCharge: Reverse charge: In the absence of a written objection within one month of receipt of the invoice, the customer is deemed to acknowledge that it is a taxable person required to file periodic VAT returns. If this condition is not met, the customer will bear, with regard to this condition, liability for payment of the tax, interest and fines due.
mention6: VAT rate: In the absence of a written objection within one month of receipt of the invoice, the customer is deemed to acknowledge that (1) the work is carried out on a residential building first occupied in a calendar year at least ten years before the date of the first invoice for this work, (2) after the work, the dwelling is used exclusively or mainly as a private residence and (3) the work is supplied and invoiced to a final consumer. If at least one of these conditions is not met, the standard VAT rate of 21% will apply and the customer will bear, with regard to these conditions, liability for payment of the tax, interest and fines due.
